name: @pipeworx/mcp-ncbi-eutils

tools.name: einfo
tools.description: List all available Entrez databases (omit db) or return field definitions and link names for a specific database (e.g. db=pubmed). Use before esearch to discover valid search fields and databases.

db.description: Optional db name; omit for global db list.

tools.name: esearch
tools.description: Search an Entrez database (e.g. pubmed, gene, nucleotide) by query term and return a list of matching UIDs (up to 10,000) with hit count. Supports pagination via retstart and sort (e.g. pub_date).

tools.name: esummary
tools.description: Fetch document summaries for one or more Entrez UIDs in a given database (e.g. pubmed), returning title, authors, journal, and publication date without the full record body.

tools.name: efetch
tools.description: Full records. Returns text (XML/GenBank/FASTA/…) per rettype.

tools.name: egquery
tools.description: Global query across all Entrez databases.

tools.name: geo_series
tools.description: Look up an NCBI GEO (Gene Expression Omnibus) series by its GSE accession, e.g. GSE75310 -> title, organism, number of samples and their GSM ids, platform (GPL id and name), experiment type (expression profiling by array / high-throughput sequencing, methylation, ChIP-seq...), release date, summary, PubMed ids, BioProject and SRA study links. Use for any question naming a GSE expression series.

tools.name: geo_search
tools.description: Search NCBI GEO (Gene Expression Omnibus) for expression series (GSE) by keywords, optionally filtered by organism and experiment type. Returns the matching series with title, organism, sample count, platform, type and release date, plus the total hit count. Follow up with geo_series for one accession.

query.description: Free-text terms, e.g. "dyskeratosis congenita" or "telomere RNA-seq"

type.description: GEO experiment type, e.g. "Expression profiling by array", "Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing", "Methylation profiling by genome tiling array"

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ncbi-eutils forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ncbi-eutils pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
